reasoning_details.text:
I'm checking each of the four cases against the rule. The 30 September order falls under the old version with its EUR 20,000 limit, so no approval is needed there, which contradicts the claim. The 1 October case under the new version above EUR 15,000 holds up. The exact EUR 15,000 case doesn't fall under the threshold, so that claim is also contradicted. Creation date decides the version even when issuance comes later, which contradicts the last claim.

I'm weighing the remaining claims against the sources. The 60-day claim is contradicted, since the two sources conflict and nothing settles which applies. For the alphabetical override claim, neither source gives any priority or supersession rule, so it's not established rather than contradicted. The last two claims are supported and contradicted, respectively.
